cases.title: Moving a pit with MOVE opens no CE window, and one U puts it back
cases.plan_item: quick MOVE (gap plan section 3 item 7; spec C37-C41 regressions; backlog W1-02)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C41 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md) and robot run 47 B.4.1. Same MOVE and U steps; only the pit's own position is read, the linked label positions of the card are not (see NOT_AUTOMATED).
cases.expected: Pick pit P3 (handle 109D56, at 53777.7,-25569.9), run MOVE with displacement 0,0 to 0,2000: AutoCAD says '1 found', the pit's insertion point is now 2000 mm higher (Y -23569.9, X unchanged), no Edit Pit, Edit Pipe, New Pit, New Pipe or Cascade window opened, and one U (echo word MOVE) puts the pit back at Y -25569.9.
cases.why_not_unit: Native MOVE has to drive CE's live link updates inside AutoCAD without a blocking window; only a live drawing shows the pit position and the window list afterwards.
not_automated: Phase 3 batch 2: the invert texts (IL) within 4000 mm of the pit (six on this drawing) are read before the move, at the pit's new place and after U, and must be the same six objects; two of them must have moved 2000 mm +- 150 (they follow the pit on 3.0.73, probe 24 Oct); the pit's cover text, its name label and the pipe ends are not read (a pipe returns only handle, object and layer through ent-read).
A CE message line about a label with no clear spot appears on this drawing after the move; it is recorded, not judged.
